title: Triangularity of the Jacobian on siphon faces, the Metzler property of its transversal component and other results
summary: We establish two structural properties of the Jacobian of a positive ODE on any invariant boundary face, i.e. on the face defined by a siphon of an associated Chemical Reaction Network. First, the Jacobian is block lower-triangular at every point of such a face, with a transversal diagonal block, which governs the species that vanish on the face, and a tangential one. Second, the transversal block is always a Metzler matrix. These two facts yield an elegant proof, in the spirit of Chemical Reaction Network theory, and a generalization of the most cited result in Mathematical Epidemiology…
